fato_historico: 2019: Thirty-two are killed and one million are evacuated as Typhoon Lekima makes landfall in Zhejiang, China. Earlier it had caused flooding in the Philippines.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a powerful surge of resilience today. Just as nature reminds us of the strength required to weather the fiercest storms and tides, you are encouraged to channel your energy toward rebuilding and renewal. It is a good time to find your center amidst any chaos and let your natural boldness guide you forward.
frase_do_dia: Every storm eventually gives way to the golden warmth of the sun.
significado_numero: Represents the spark of hope and the promise of new beginnings.
conselho: Consider how you can transform current challenges into your greatest personal growth opportunities today.
